caption: The drawing depicts a lantern and its mounting in a realistic style. The main object, centrally placed in the upper part of the composition, is a lantern with a polygonal, tapered shape and a brown metallic frame. The lantern has glass panels on its sides with visible reflections, a slightly domed metallic top, and is suspended by a curved wire handle. The lantern's frame and top are represented in shades of brown, gray, and metallic silver. Below this, in the lower left section of the drawing, there is a smaller line drawing showing the lantern mounted on a simple wooden post with a horizontal arm, positioned on a sloped ground. This part of the drawing is done in minimal detail and primarily uses brown ink, lacking the shading and color of the larger lantern above. The background is off-white and unadorned. The bottom right corner contains a signature.
title: Sperm Oil Street Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
